current_known_facts: The training pipeline in `train_ebcar` branches on `cfg.use_dedicated_attention` to select the dedicated-attention configuration and loads corresponding weights.
The reranker is configured by this flag and returned after the training loop completes.
Validation loss is computed as the mean over the number of validation batches.
No accepted formula package exists for the contrastive loss or embedding enrichment mechanism.
